checks.verification: Independent SI free-electron density of states and Fermi-Dirac evaluation: EF=hbar^2*(3pi^2n)^(2/3)/(2m)=3.8626018590868194e-19J. Simpson integration over the stated interval with20000steps gives1.2972804017388336e21occupied states; center-only approximation gives8.842566437535284e19. Both agree with authored values; different approximation scopes are explicit.

Logical principal-shell capacities2n^2 give2+8+18+32=60electrons in complete shells1..4. With63electrons there are three, not one, in shell5; logical n,l ordering gives5s^2 5p^1. The claim of sodium-like filling is inconsistent;61would leave5s^1.

Independent radioisotope power check uses N=(1kg/0.238kg mol^-1)*NA and decay constant ln2/(87.7years), multiplied by5.50MeV per decay. Thermal power about558.43W. A factor1000kg/g error in the draft was corrected before publication.
